api.name: IMS Export Subscriptions API
api.description: API for viewing and creating subscriptions. Subscriptions deliver data from plant IMS's to Omnia TSDB

authorizationServer.name: iiot-public-client-imssubscriptions
authorizationServer.description: Public client for Omnia IIoT IMS Subscriptions API

request.description: Either UId or System Id of IMS and IMS tag name of sensor for which to create subscription.

queryParameters.name: destination
queryParameters.description: The destination for subscription. Default is timeseries DB. (tsdb, datalake, all). Choosing tsdb as destination will create a subscription for datalake as well. The converse however, does not apply.

request.description: >System Id of IMS and IMS tag name of sensor for which to create subscription.

queryParameters.name: lifeTime
queryParameters.description: The lifetime of the real time subscription. The default is '10m'. Max is '35d'. Valid examples: 60s, 10m, 24h, 15d.

queryParameters.name: expirationTime
queryParameters.description: Format - date-time (as date-time in RFC3339). The expiration time of the subscription in utc time. Max is 35 days from request time. If given takes priority over 'lifetime' parameter.
